title: SEAD · mission sequence
subtitle: ISR, stimulation, strike and follow-through
description: A source-structured visualization of the Mitchell Institute SEAD concept, retaining the published phase organization while keeping all positions and motion illustrative.

citations.locator: Figure 9; SEAD phases across the 24-hour presentation period

assumptions: Phase names follow the report's conceptual SEAD sequence; displayed geography, timing, actor counts and routes are editorial illustration.
No sensor, weapon, threat, targeting or kill-chain performance is modeled.
Timeline seconds are presentation time only and do not correspond to the source's real-world clock scale.
Actors are abstract research records rather than a claim about an actual force package.

phases.title: Continuous ISR
phases.narrative: Establish persistent intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance as the background condition for the SEAD concept.

phases.title: Stimulate / Decoy / Jam
phases.narrative: Represent the report's use of CCA to stimulate, deceive and electronically affect surface-air defenses.

phases.title: Strike SAGs
phases.narrative: Show the conceptual strike phase against surface-to-air groups using a mix of CCA and crewed aircraft.

phases.title: Harass / EA
phases.narrative: Continue pressure with harassment and electronic attack after the principal strike phase.

phases.title: Harass & BDA
phases.narrative: Close with continued harassment and battle-damage-assessment activity as presented in the source figure.

actors.label: CCA SEAD element
actors.role: Abstract CCA element representing stimulation, electronic attack and strike support
